question: What is called nondual where all shines the same?
premises: This is dual, this is not, and this is dual-and-nondual, where all shines the same.
inference: Equipollent shining of the alternatives is itself called nondual.
plain_english: This is dual, this is not, and this is dual-and-nondual — where all shines the same, that is called nondual.
